scriptsHelp.//: Shown by `npm run help`. One entry per script above; add one when you add a script.

dev.desc: Run the worker locally with wrangler dev (reads .dev.vars)

dev:db.desc: Local stand-in for Neon (PGlite) so wrangler dev runs without a database; port 4444 by default
examples: PORT=54444 npm run dev:db   # keep DATABASE_URL's port in sync
npm run dev:db -- --memory   # fresh database every start

deploy.desc: Deploy the worker to Cloudflare (CI also deploys on every push to main)

test.desc: Run the tests once (vitest, in-memory Postgres)

test:watch.desc: Run the tests in watch mode

type-check.desc: Type-check with tsc, no output files

mcp-token.desc: Manage personal access tokens for /mcp (needs ADMIN_SECRET; BILDEBANK_URL defaults to production)
examples: npm run mcp-token -- set-access "Kari Nordmann" read
BILDEBANK_URL=http://localhost:8787 npm run mcp-token -- list   # local worker

db:generate.desc: Generate a SQL migration in drizzle/ from src/db/schema.ts

db:migrate.desc: Apply drizzle migrations to the database in DATABASE_URL

db:studio.desc: Open Drizzle Studio to browse the database in DATABASE_URL

npx wrangler tail.desc: Stream production logs, including the mcp.write / upload_link.upload attribution lines
